info.title: Swiss Mobility API (B2P API)
info.description:
The SBB Swiss Mobility API is an interface that you can integrate into your own distribution system. Timetable and fare details are made available to you via this interface. Initially, we are introducing SBB Swiss Mobilty API for Swiss domestic transport services, but we will be constantly developing it and adding new products and functions. There are two ways to use the service:

  • Either integrate the SBB Swiss Mobility API as a full version, so that bookings are made directly via your distribution environment
  • Or use the Affiliate solution, with a link to the SBB webshop or SBB mobile

Before you request access to our API, please get in contact with SBB Digital Affiliates by sending an email stating your intentions and goal. Please note that the purpose of our API is to generate sales turnover through it. Retrieving timetables and prices only is not permitted due to the Look2Book Ratio. Please check out our GTC as well. On the right you can find the contact details and the links to the important websites.

post.description: The barcode service generates a barcode from a collection of attributes which are passed by the caller. The attributes have a type and a semantic attached to them. parameters.name: Scroll-Context
parameters.description:
Based on a previous search-response, earlier or later connections for the same trip can be retrieved by scrolling back and forward (by a pointer-context). You must use the same GET request parameters as in the previous trips-request. Additionally either of the given values in the previous response-header for "Scrollback-Context" or "Scrollforward-Context" can be set for "Scroll-Context" to force optional scrolling.
See Trip::scrollChecksum

parameters.name: originId
parameters.description: The origin UIC code of the trip.

parameters.name: destinationId
parameters.description: The destination UIC code of the trip.

parameters.name: viaId
parameters.description: The UIC code of forced via(s) during the trip, relates to trainType (number of `,` in trainType +1 viaId).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The desired departure date (local date at origin of trip if arrivalDeparture="ED" or at destination if arrivalDeparture="LA"), relates to time.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The desired departure time (local time analog date), relates to date.

parameters.name: arrivalDeparture
parameters.description: Search by earliest departure "ED" or latest arrival "LA".

parameters.name: trainType
parameters.description:
Allows restriction of TransportProduct-categories per PUBLIC_JOURNEY segment and relates to viaId. If nothing is set all TransportProduct-categories may result by default.
For a trip A(origin)--(segment0)--B(via0)--(segment1)--C(destination), the desired TransportProduct-categories for each segment may be restricted.
Use ',' to separate different segments (via's) and ';' to separate multiple TransportProduct-categories like {ICE/TGV/RJ; EC/IC; IR; RE/D; BOAT; S/SN/R; BUS; CABLEWAY; ARZ/EXT; TRAMWAY} per segment, see [v580 de:Verkehrsmittelkategorien](https://github.com/SchweizerischeBundesbahnen/journey-service/blob/master/TransportMode.md).
For e.g. related to A-B-C above:
- "IR" restrict to InterRegio for segment0 if viaId=B is given (or otherweise for the whole trip if viaId is not given at all)
- "EC/IC,IR" restrict to EuroCity/InterCity for segment0, for segment1 (and perhaps other via's following) only InterRegio is considered where viaId=B must be set
- "EC/IC;ICE/TGV/RJ,IR;EC/IC" restrict segment0 to EC/IC or ICE/TGV/RJ, segment1 to IR or EC/IC (and perhaps other via's following) where viaId=B must be set
- ",IR" no restriction for segment0, restrict segment1 to IR (and perhaps other via's following) where viaId=B must be set

parameters.name: alternateMatch
parameters.description:
Allows control over displaying of cancelled trips with an alternate connection.IRRELEVANT delivers as is (cancelled and alternate without enrichment of alternate)
BOTH delivers both trips of 1:1 alternative (cancelled and alternate with enrichment of alternative)
ALTERNATE_ONLY delivers only the 1:1 alternate trips
CANCELLED_ONLY delivers only the 1:1 cancelled trips

parameters.name: includeBefore
parameters.description: Indicate the minimum number of search results returned before related dateTime.

parameters.name: includeAfter
parameters.description: Indicate the minimum number of search results returned after related dateTime.

get.description:
The offers service calculates all possible offers for a specified tripId to our offers logic. For example we offer a day-pass if the fare is cheaper or not much more expensive than a regular point to point ticket.The offered fare is cached for max 15 minutes. Please note that under heavy system load the cache might expire even earlier.
The external ids for trips can be retrieved with the trips service.
There is no limitation for the number of passengers. We highly recommend not to ask for more than 5, especially if you send the request for different passenger types.
Please note that this service is not designed as a price information service and it has to be used only as part of the booking process. For pure price information please use the 'prices' service.
If you are subscribed to our affiliation programm you have to include your ID as an URL parameter, for further information please contact digitalsales@sbb.ch. 
Detailed Information about fares and conditions you can find here: https://www.sbb.ch/en/station-services/services/customerdialogue/fare-conditions-for-your-journey.htm

get.description:
Get all STATIONs known resp. actrively routed. Provides a download of all transferable STATIONs known and routed by Hafas and managed by DiDok (UIC source) resp. INFO+ (planned routes).
There are more than 65'000 such STATIONs, therefore a paging mechanism is provided to step through all potential hits.
All stations will be updated on a weekly base, because of rare changes, please do not use this service more frequently!

get.description:
The group trip offers service calculates all possible offers for a specified tripId to our offers logic. For example we offer a group day-pass if the fare is cheaper or not much more expensive than a regular group point to point ticket.The offered fare is cached for max 15 minutes. Please note that under heavy system load the cache might expire even earlier.
The external ids for trips can be retrieved with the trips service.
Group trips must have at least 10 passengers in total. There is no upper limitation for the number of passengers and passenger groups, but we recommend to only send one group per used customer segment code.
Please note that this service is not designed as a price information service and it has to be used only as part of the booking process. Getting pure price information is currently not supported for group trips.
Affiliate links are not available for group trips. 
Detailed Information about fares and conditions you can find here: https://www.sbb.ch/en/station-services/services/customerdialogue/fare-conditions-for-your-journey.htm
